property.name: Continuity
property.summary: Describes whether the segment between this point and the next point in the curve is discrete or continuous.

property.name: Position
property.summary: Position of the CurveKey in the curve.

property.name: TangentIn
property.summary: Describes the tangent when approaching this point from the previous point in the curve.

property.name: TangentOut
property.summary: Describes the tangent when leaving this point to the next point in the curve.

property.name: Value
property.summary: Describes the value of this point.
